specs.title: unproven — an accepted requirement with no passing test reads unproven, and is not waiting
proven — a current passing proof makes a requirement proven
reworded — editing the requirement after acceptance wins over any proof, and it is waiting
never accepted / a guess — both are waiting on you to accept the requirements
accept — pins the current PRD text, clears reworded, and leaves the screen not waiting
accept — strips a crawl guess flag and pins, without touching a body line that begins "guess:"
accept — refused when there is nothing to accept (already accepted, nothing reworded)
renders — the detail shows exactly one accept gate, two panes, and no gate B / draft gate
renders — accepting from the board pins the requirements (the gate is a real wire)
R1 — home is one CARD per screen: titles + a cover, never a four-column strip
R2 — the detail is two columns, each scrolling on its own
R3 — a requirement is a title that EXPANDS; a test leads with its flow name, not a requirement
R4 — requirement state is computed: reworded wins, else proven / unproven — and it re-derives
R5 — requirements and tests are many-to-many by tag, and the link lights up on hover
R6 — a test declares the coverage it proves; a requirement lists every test that covers it
R7 — specboard owns no wireframe or design: no design affordance, nothing rendered
R8 — ONE human gate: accept the requirements; no gate B, no wireframe
R9 — search across requirement text, grouped into areas, a group with no match hides
R10 — a test opens to its evidence and can be run; the whole log opens in a floating window
R2 — both positions are shown in full, each naming where it came from
R3 — the tool never picks: resolving is refused until you choose a side
R4 — resolving records which side lost, and offers the rewrite of that file
R5 — a decision survives a rescan that reorders and swaps the sides
R5 — undo puts a settled conflict back, and the scanner is never asked to pick
R1/R2 — the panel opens on the click and streams the job while it runs
R4 — a person's second run takes over the running one: accepted, not refused
R4 — a run may nest inside the run driving it, and nesting is bounded
running one screen leaves every other screen's E2E result standing
R6/R8 — a run saves its whole log, and records every test case on its own
R8 — a run that matched no test is recorded as an error, never 0 of 0 passing
R8 — running ONE case leaves every other case's steps and log standing
R6/R8 — a case keeps a LOG HISTORY, and a scoped run says which case it was
R8 — EVERY case that has run can expand its steps, not only the one you clicked
R7 — the run panel offers no background run
R7 — the panel and its log stay on screen after the run ends
R5 — cancel stops the job, and cancelling nothing is refused not crashed
R1 — the form persists what cannot be guessed, and reads it back
R1 — start mode saves backend and frontend, in order
R3 — a crawled screen lands as a guess: one CARD, waiting on you to accept it, never a build gate

R5 — rerunning marks new routes new and leaves a settled row alone
